If you are interested in working with an awesome team on the bleeding edge of AI, join us! Our group's work covers a diverse range of topics, from tabular foundation models across AutoML to reinforcement learning. As our field develops at a rapid pace, we recommend checking our most recent publications for an up-to-date overview of our research.
BSc/MSc Students
Please note that we accept only BSc/MSc students enrolled at the University of Freiburg for projects, theses, or teaching and research assistant roles; we do not offer internships. Further information, such as available topics, can be found here.
PhD Students
We are currently hiring PhD candidates solely through the ELLIS PhD Program. The ELLIS PhD Program is a core pillar of the ELLIS initiative, which aims to foster the best talent in machine learning and related fields by pairing outstanding students with leading researchers in Europe.
Calls for applications open in October each year and are announced on the ELLIS website. The deadline is November 15. Your application must explain why you want to work in our lab; otherwise, it will not be reviewed further
FYI: The salary scale for full-time positions is TV-L E13, 100% (a very good salary for living in Freiburg).
Postdoctoral Researchers and Research Engineers
We have no open calls for postdoc or research engineer positions at this time. Positions are filled either through announced openings or directly by the group leads.
